summary: Learn Excel and Power BI methods for procurement spend screening, red flags, bid patterns, and investigation hand-offs. View the course outline.
lede: Procurement fraud analytics training helps procurement, audit, finance and compliance professionals screen purchasing data for patterns that may warrant review. Using Excel and Power BI, learners practise classifying spend, testing exceptions, reviewing conflict-of-interest indicators and bid patterns, and mapping supplier connections. They also prepare evidence logs and structured hand-offs, treating indicators as prompts for further examination rather than proof of fraud.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review procurement activity, investigate concerns, or oversee controls for purchasing and supplier relationships.
modules: Spend Analytics with Excel and Power Query
Procurement Red Flags in Power BI
Procurement Fraud Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Working familiarity with procurement processes and basic spreadsheet use is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel; Power BI access is useful for the dashboard exercises. Use of organizational procurement data depends on authorization and appropriate redaction.
